messages:
maria: Quick share — ran end-to-end sims for rwd-13B quantized (4-bit) across GPUs and regions to pick Dedicated pool concurrency headroom. Posting the condensed numbers.

maria: Key context: seq_len=512, steady-state traffic simulated from PLG profile, tokens-per-request avg=120, batching enabled. Autoscaler still on (scale-up threshold 75% util).

maria: Raw sim snippet (aggregated):
```
GPU   conc  p50(ms) p95(ms) p99(ms) throughput tok/s
A100   4    85     210     560     12,000
A100   8    95     380    1,400    22,000
H100   8    70     190     450     26,000
H100  12    85     300    1,200    36,000
T4     2   160     420    1,100     5,000
```

maria: Observations: p99 balloons on A100 past conc=6. H100 tolerates higher conc before p99 degrades. Throughput scales but at cost of tail latency.

jonah: Nice. Did you split by region? Asia had ~10% higher p95 due to network egress impact on batching, right?

maria: yes — us-west and eu-central matched numbers above; ap-southeast added +8–12% on p95/p99 and slightly reduced batching efficiency (fewer simultaneous warm prefixes).

samir: For Dedicated pools our SLA target is p95 < 300ms, p99 < 1s for realtime routes. Looks like A100@8 violates p95 and p99. I'd cap concurrency at 4–6 for A100.

eva: For cost tradeoffs: A100 at conc=4 gives lower p99 but halves throughput vs conc=8. That means double GPUs for same capacity. Need to show dollar/TPS.

cheng: Any kernel/quant differences? Did you try fused attention kernels vs fallback?

maria: Good call — ran both. Fused kernels reduce p50 by ~10% and p95 by ~15% on H100; on A100 fused helps p50 but p99 still climbs because KV-cache memory pressure triggers OOM backoffs at high conc. Quantization (4-bit) is fine for throughput but increases variance for some prompt shapes — more retries in our eval set.

maria: Proposed config for Dedicated pools serving rwd-13B (prod):
- H100 pool: target_concurrency=8, autoscale_headroom=25% (scale at 75% util)
- A100 pool: target_concurrency=4, autoscale_headroom=30%
- Fallback routing: if H100 capacity exhausted, route to A100 with lower concurrency and rerank fallback to faster small model for <200 token responses.

samir: Agree on H100=8, A100=4. Need to add safety cap on burst scaling to avoid noisy neighbor on host. Set max_burst=2 extra GPUs per zone.

jonah: Can we tune the autoscaler to look at p95 instead of only GPU util? Current scaler is util-based and misses tail spikes.

infra-bot: autoscaler:policy:update requested by @jonah on pool=rwd-13B-h100. Status: pending review.

maria: I ran a quick cost delta (approx): keeping A100 at conc=4 vs conc=8 increases committed GPUs by ~1.9x for same QPS, ~+55% monthly cost but reduces p99 outages in our eval set from 2.3% to 0.3%.

eva: Product question: are we comfortable with fallback to smaller model for short responses? latency wise it's OK, but need quality guardrails.

cheng: For kernels: we'll enable fused-attn on H100 by default, keep A100 on conservative kernels while we fix KV mem fragmentation. That should buy some tail room.

samir: Action items:
- samir: add safety cap max_burst=2 and implement per-pool concurrency settings (H100=8/A100=4).
- jonah: spike to add p95-based scaling signal prototype (trace-based).
- maria: paste full sim artifacts to S3 and link to eval dashboard.

jonah: SGTM, will start p95 signal POC tomorrow.

maria: thanks all. tagging @cheng @eva for visibility on kernel + product fallback implications. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy:scale-update applied to rwd-13B-h100 pool (staged), change_id=deploy-202403-789. Rollout: 0/3 hosts.
